label: prf:h2o-bond-angle-shift
title: Proof of h2o bond angle shift
html:
Proof. Proof of h2o bond angle shift

Proof. Writing b = 2as, the energy minus its value at \theta_0 - s is the perfect square a\bigl(\theta - (\theta_0 - s)\bigr)^2 \ge 0, so \theta_0 - s = \theta_0 - b/(2a) is the global minimiser. The Lean sibling proves this inequality over \mathbb{R}. \qquad\blacksquare
